## Second Quarter 2027 Conference Call


Nov 12, 2026 • 4:00pm CST


Interested individuals may join the teleconference by dialing (844) 539-3703 or (412) 652-1273 and asking to join the Crown Crafts, Inc. call.


A telephone replay of the teleconference will be available three hours after the call through November 25, 2026. To access the replay, dial (844) 512-2921 in the United States or (412) 317-6671 from international locations and enter replay access code 13762511.
